item.title: Metformin and ursodeoxycholic acid do not improve long COVID recovery
item.description: 1. In this randomized controlled trial, neither metformin nor ursodeoxycholic acid improved recovery from long COVID compared with placebo in adults. 2. Participants who recovered from long COVID showed reductions in multiple cytokine levels, while those who did not recover showed no meaningful changes. item.title: Ex vivo gene therapy for cystinosis had acceptable safety and improved disease biomarkers
item.description: 1. In this phase 1–2 open-label study, autologous lentiviral hematopoietic stem-cell gene therapy for cystinosis was associated with sustained engraftment and reduced white-cell cystine levels. 2. Adverse events were largely consistent with myeloablative conditioning and preexisting disease, with no evidence of clonal expansion or leukoproliferative complications. item.title: Safety and efficacy profile of first-in-class oral p53 reactivator rezatapopt
item.description: 1. In this phase 1-2 single-group trial, the p53 reactivator rezatapopt was well-tolerated in adults with solid tumors harboring the TP53 Y220C mutation. 2. Preliminary efficacy data showed dose-dependent tumor regression in participants with ovarian, breast, and other cancers.
